Abwechselnd wird eine Linie gezogen. Wer: Players take turns drawing a line. Whoever closes a box gets a point and goes again.
Das Brett ist ein Punkteraster. Wenn du: The board is a grid of dots. When it's your turn, tap a free line between two neighboring dots.

Schliesst deine Linie kein Kästchen, ist: If your line doesn't close a box, it's your opponent's turn.
